items.title: This week's "node2shell" Brotli vulnerability (CVE-2026-111497) is exploitable in Python, other consumers of Brotli
items.blurb: The Brotli flaw behind Node2Shell (CVE-2026-111497) affects many libraries and applications using HTTP with Brotli or brotlicffi installed. Check your versions and upgrade to the fix.
